chapter: Family and downtown New Orleans childhood
title: Growing up downtown near Howard Avenue and Canal
summary: He lived downtown between Howard and Canal near Dryades and Rampart; he says musicians simply gather wherever they can enjoy one another.

blocks.x: Mm-hmm. So once you moved to New Orleans, what neighborhood did you live in?
Did we live in then? We lived in the area between Howard Avenue and Canal, around in Drys and Ramport. Yeah. Girard.

You weren't really uptown. Yeah, really. Were there any musicians who lived in that neighborhood? Do you remember any? In the downtown neighborhood? Yeah. Around where you were living?
